description:
My field manual for living alone, Hold the House (17 dollars, free first chapter): https://wadeguide.netlify.app

I did my time in the service. This channel is the practical half of what they taught me: the field skills, the habits, the gear and the paperwork, explained plainly for people who never had to learn it the hard way.

Everything here is sourced. When I cite a method I name the manual it comes from. I do not give benefits advice on individual cases and I am not accredited to.

Wade Merrill is a fictional character. No real person is depicted or impersonated, and no real branch, unit, or deployment is depicted or claimed.
